<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_RoomService" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/evanstonian-room-service">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_RoomServiceCall" name="Room service call"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_RoomService">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Guest" name="Guest"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_RoomService" name="The Evanstonian Room Service" processRef="Process_RoomService"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CallRoomService" name="Calls room service" sourceRef="Participant_Guest" targetRef="StartEvent_RoomServiceCall"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_RoomService" name="Room service order handling" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_RoomService">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Manager" name="Room-service manager">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_RoomServiceCall</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TakeOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitTicket</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GiveOrderToSommelier</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssignOrderToWaiter</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PrepareSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Kitchen" name="Kitchen">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareFood</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Sommelier" name="Sommelier (wine waiter)">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FetchWine</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Waiter" name="Waiter">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReadyCart</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PrepareJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DeliverOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReturnToStation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_OtherOrderCheck</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DeferBilling</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_BillingMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DebitGuestAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_OrderBilled</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_RoomServiceCall" name="Room service call received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_01</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_RoomServiceCall" messageRef="Msg_RoomServiceCall"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_TakeOrder" name="Take down order">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_01</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_02</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SubmitTicket" name="Submit order ticket to kitchen">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_02</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_03</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_GiveOrderToSommelier" name="Give order to sommelier">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_03</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_04</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AssignOrderToWaiter" name="Assign order to waiter">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_04</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_05</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PrepareSplit" name="Start preparation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_05</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_06</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_07</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_08</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_09</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PrepareFood" name="Prepare food">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_06</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_FetchWine" name="Fetch wine and prepare other alcoholic beverages">
      <bpmn:documentation>About eighty percent of room-service orders include wine or another alcoholic beverage.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_07</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReadyCart" name="Ready cart (tablecloth and silverware)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_08</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks" name="Prepare nonalcoholic drinks">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_09</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PrepareJoin" name="Food, wine and cart ready">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DeliverOrder" name="Deliver food, wine and cart to guest room">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReturnToStation" name="Return to room-service station">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OtherOrderCheck" name="Waiter has another order to prepare or deliver?" default="Flow_18">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_18</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DeferBilling" name="Defer billing">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_19</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BillingMerge" name="Billing ready">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_18</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_19</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_20</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DebitGuestAccount" name="Debit guest's account">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_20</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_21</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderBilled" name="Order billed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_21</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_RoomServiceCall" targetRef="Task_TakeOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_TakeOrder" targetRef="Task_SubmitTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_SubmitTicket" targetRef="Task_GiveOrderToSommelier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_GiveOrderToSommelier" targetRef="Task_AssignOrderToWaiter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_AssignOrderToWaiter" targetRef="Gateway_PrepareSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepareSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareFood"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepareSplit" targetRef="Task_FetchWine"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepareSplit" targetRef="Task_ReadyCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepareSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_PrepareFood" targetRef="Gateway_PrepareJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_FetchWine" targetRef="Gateway_PrepareJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_ReadyCart" targetRef="Gateway_PrepareJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks" targetRef="Gateway_PrepareJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepareJoin" targetRef="Task_DeliverOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_DeliverOrder" targetRef="Task_ReturnToStation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_ReturnToStation" targetRef="Gateway_OtherOrderCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" name="Another order pending" sourceRef="Gateway_OtherOrderCheck" targetRef="Task_DeferBilling">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${anotherOrderPending == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" name="No other order pending" sourceRef="Gateway_OtherOrderCheck" targetRef="Gateway_BillingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_DeferBilling" targetRef="Gateway_BillingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingMerge" targetRef="Task_DebitGuestAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Task_DebitGuestAccount" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderBilled"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
